info.description:
Freelancers and their clients on the same page: tasks, projects, boards, reports.

Sign in with POST /auth/login: it sets an httpOnly cookie that every other call sends.
In this UI, sign in first and the cookie goes along with the next requests.
Errors come as {"error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}.
info.title: Helpic API

get.description: The last 30 days, the newest first: failed requests, panics, background jobs. A page at a time, with how many match in all. Requests show their route, never the path.

parameters.description: Part of the message or of any attribute
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Entries per page, 50 by default, at most 200
parameters.name: limit

403.description: Not an admin, or two-factor is off

get.description: Totals now; the last days (today included) against the days before them, also day by day. Days are the app's time zone's. Counts only, never anyone's content.

parameters.description: The period, 7 to 365 days; 30 by default
parameters.name: days

403.description: Not an admin, or two-factor is off

get.description: Every account, the newest first: who they are and how much they use Helpic. A page at a time, with how many match in all.

parameters.description: Part of the email or the name
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: active (in the last 7 days), idle (not in the last 30) or never
parameters.name: activity

parameters.description: created (newest first, the default), last_active or tasks
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Accounts per page, 25 by default, at most 100
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Invalid role, activity, sort, page or limit

403.description: Not an admin, or two-factor is off

get.description: One account in full: its team, how much it has done (counts only) and the days it used Helpic over the last 26 weeks.

403.description: Not an admin, or two-factor is off

get.description: Tasks closed for good, the most recently archived first: shared work whose report was paid, and personal tasks put away by hand. A page at a time, with how many there are in all; a page past the last is empty.

parameters.description: A client's or freelancer's ID, or personal
parameters.name: with

parameters.description: Tasks per page, 10 by default, at most 200
parameters.name: limit

200.description: the page's tasks and the total

post.description: Multipart, one "file" part, up to MAX_UPLOAD_MB. The type is read from the bytes.
post.summary: Attach a file to a task

get.description: Always as a download, except PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP images with inline=1.

parameters.description: 1 to show a safe image in place
parameters.name: inline

post.description: Sets the httpOnly auth cookie that every other endpoint reads. An account with two-factor on answers a right password without a code with 403 TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED; send the same again with the code.

400.description: Invalid input, or a wrong code (field code)

403.description: The password is right; the account also needs a code (TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED)

429.description: Too many attempts from this address, wrong passwords for this email, or wrong codes for this account

post.description: Ends this device's session and clears the auth cookies.
Emails a one-time link to the account with this email. The answer is the same whether there is one or not.
post.summary: Ask for a password reset link

204.description: Sent, if there is such an account

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

post.description: Signs out every device; sign in with the new password.
post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

400.description: Invalid password, or the link is invalid, used or expired (field token)

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

post.description: Swaps the refresh cookie for a new one and sets a new access cookie. A refresh token used again after it was replaced ends the session.

429.description: Too many refreshes from this address

post.description: Emails a confirmation link. The account is created when that link is opened, not before. An email that already has an account gets a note saying so instead; the answer is the same, so it doesn't tell who has an account.

429.description: Too many sign-ups from this address

post.description: Creates the freelancer account and signs this browser in. The link is the proof the inbox is theirs.

400.description: The link is invalid, replaced, used or expired (field token)

409.description: The email was taken before the link was opened

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

The same query as /board, without tasks.

parameters.description: Every column ID, in the new order
parameters.name: body

post.description: The board's freelancer, or the author of the project (project_id).

put.summary: Rename a column or change its category

delete.description: Its tasks move to another column of the same bucket.

post.description: Either side of the board.

delete.description: Takes it off every task too.

post.description: Into a column after a card (column_id, after_task_id), or on the all board into a lane (lane).

get.description: Freelancers only. Each with their open task count.
Oldest first.

post.description: Opened from the link emailed to the new address; needs no signed-in user.

200.description: The account, with its new email

400.description: The link is invalid, used or expired, or the email was taken since (field token)

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

get.description: Clients only; a team member sees the company owner's.

post.description: Emails the invitation link to the client; only they get it.

Public. Creates the client account (name, password, confirmation) or signs in to the existing one (password, and a code when it has two-factor on), links it with the freelancer and sets the auth cookie.

400.description: Invalid input, or a wrong code (field code)

403.description: The password is right; the account also needs a code (TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED)

429.description: Too many wrong codes for this account

post.description: Public: the invitation page.

put.description: What a freelancer bills in: USD, EUR, GBP, UAH, PLN or CAD. Refused while a task still has a price, so amounts are not relabeled.
Needs the current password. Emails a confirmation link to the new address; the email changes once it is opened (POST /email-changes/confirm).

400.description: Invalid input, the same email, or taken

get.description: Notifications are emailed a few minutes late, together, and not once read in the app.

put.description: The notification kinds to email; an empty list turns email off. See "available".
put.summary: Choose what you get by email

put.description: "en" or "uk": the interface, and the email and Telegram messages you get.
Needs the current password. Signs out every other device.
An amount like "40" or "37.50" in the freelancer's currency; null or "" clears it. Tasks billed by the hour are priced at it, unless their project has its own rate.

200.description: sessions, the most recently used first

delete.description: Its access token works until it expires, minutes at most; it can't be refreshed.

put.description: The notification kinds sent to the connected chat; see "available" in GET /me/telegram.

post.description: A one-time t.me link to the bot, good for 15 minutes: opening it in Telegram connects that chat.
post.summary: Get a link that connects Telegram

503.description: No bot on this server, or it isn't ready

post.description: Needs the current password and a code from the app or a recovery code.
With a code from the app the setup's secret went into. Signs out every other device and returns the recovery codes, shown this once.

409.description: No setup was started, or it was started again elsewhere

post.description: Needs the current password and a code from the app or a recovery code. The old codes stop working; the new ones are shown this once.

Needs the current password. Returns a new secret for an authenticator app, as a QR code and as text; it is used once a code from it confirms it (POST /me/two-factor/enable). Starting again replaces it.

get.description: The latest 50, and how many are unread.
Cheap enough to poll.

post.description: A client names the freelancer; a freelancer the client, or none for a personal project.

delete.description: Its creator only; its tasks stay, out of the project.

post.description: The author only. One person (user_id) or several (user_ids). They're notified and can see the project.

delete.description: The author only. The author stays. Someone taken off no longer sees the project.

get.description: Who is on the project. Its author also gets who they can still invite: the freelancer, and the client's employees and contractors.

put.description: A freelancer on the project only. Their tasks in it billed by the hour are priced at this rate instead of their own; null or "" clears it.
put.summary: Set your hourly rate on a project

get.description: A freelancer's own; a client's once sent. Team members get none.

post.description: Freelancers only. Snapshots the tasks completed in the period (in project_ids, if any), leaving out ones a paid report covers.

delete.description: Its freelancer, and only while it is a draft. A sent report stays with the client.

get.description: Its client sees only the sending and the payment.

put.summary: Rewrite a task's notes in a draft

delete.summary: Drop a task from a draft

post.description: The report's client only. Its tasks go to the archive for good; the freelancer is notified.
Freezes it, its prices and currency; the client is notified.
post.summary: Send a draft to its client

get.description: Open ones first, then by due date.

post.description: A client names the freelancer; a freelancer the client, or none for a personal task. A project, or a board column (status_id), fixes who it's with.

put.description: Title, description, due date, project. Its creator or its freelancer, in any status.

post.description: Puts your own personal task away for good: it leaves the boards and can't be changed. Shared work is archived when its report is paid.

put.description: An empty freelancer_id takes the assignee off. The task's author stays a participant.

400.description: Not a freelancer on the project

get.description: Who changed what and when, oldest first. Team members don't see price changes.

put.description: Replaces them with labels of the task's board.

post.description: Someone from the client's side; they're notified, and a contractor sees the task from now on. A contractor can add people only to tasks they set.

delete.description: Anyone can take themselves off; the freelancer and the creator stay. A contractor taken off no longer sees the task.

get.description: The task's client and their company's members and contractors, saying who is on it already. Empty for a personal task.
get.summary: Who can be on a task

put.description: The task's freelancer only, in any status. At a fixed price a null price clears it; billed by the hour, the price is the task's time at the freelancer's rate.

post.description: To an exact board column (status_id), or to the first column of a category (status), as the role rules allow.

get.description: Clients only. The owner also gets the members and pending invitations.

post.description: Public. Creates the member's account, adds it to the company and sets the auth cookie.
Public: the join page.
Emails the join link to the invited address; only they get it. They join with a new account.

put.description: A member sees all the company's tasks; a contractor only the ones they set or were added to.
put.summary: Make someone a member or a contractor

get.description: Newest day first. For whoever sees the task's price.

post.description: The task's freelancer only, until it's archived.

get.description: Null when none runs.

post.summary: Start a timer on a task

active_days.description: ActiveDays is on how many of the last 30 days they used Helpic.

last_active.description: LastActive is the last day they used Helpic, YYYY-MM-DD; null if never.

active_days.description: ActiveDays is on how many of the last 30 days they used Helpic.

active_since.description:
ActiveSince is the Monday 26 weeks back; ActiveOn the days since then
they used Helpic, YYYY-MM-DD, oldest first.

last_active.description: LastActive is the last day they used Helpic, YYYY-MM-DD; null if never.

partners.description: Partners are a freelancer's clients, or a client's freelancers.

sessions.description: Sessions are their signed-in devices now.

day.description: Day is YYYY-MM-DD in the app's time zone.

attrs.description:
Attrs are what was logged with it: for a request the method, route,
status, duration, IP and who made it; for a failure the error.

warnings.description: Warnings and Errors are counted over the last 24 hours, whatever the filter.

active.description: Active is how many people used Helpic on any of the days.

from.description: From and To are the period's first and last day, YYYY-MM-DD.

previous_days.description: PreviousDays is the period before, as long, to compare with.

role.description: Role is owner, member or contractor.

can_delete.description: CanDelete is true for the uploader.

is_image.description: IsImage marks a picture the browser may preview.

code.description:
Code is asked for once the password is right, when the account has
two-factor on: six digits from the app, or a recovery code.

recovery_codes_left.description: RecoveryCodesLeft is how many unused recovery codes there are; 0 while off.

qr.description: QR is an SVG image of URI, as a data: URL.

secret.description: Secret is for typing in by hand, base32.

uri.description: URI is the otpauth:// link the QR code carries.

can_manage.description:
CanManage is true for the author of the project the board was opened
for, and on a pair's board for its freelancer.

merged.description:
Merged is true for the all board: its columns are lanes merging the
pairs' columns of one name, moved to with MoveRequest.Lane.

after_task_id.description:
AfterTaskID is the card the moved one goes right after; empty puts it
at the top of the column.

lane.description: Lane, instead of ColumnID, moves the card to a lane of the all board.

can_edit.description: CanEdit is true for the author, who may edit and delete it.

available.description:
Available are the kinds that can be emailed; DefaultKinds those on
until the user chooses.

kinds.description: Kinds are emailed; none means no email.

can_set_rate.description:
CanSetRate is true for a freelancer on the project; MyHourlyRateCents
is the rate they set on it (null: their own rate applies).

project_id.description: ProjectID is the one-project form of ProjectIDs, still accepted.

project_ids.description: ProjectIDs limits the report to these projects; none means all.

can_delete.description: CanDelete is true for the freelancer while the report is a draft.

can_edit.description: CanEdit is true for the freelancer while the report is a draft.

can_mark_paid.description: CanMarkPaid is true for the client of a sent, unpaid report.

client.description: Client is null for a report on personal work.

in_uah.description:
InUAH is the total in hryvnias at the NBU's official rate, on a single
report in another currency; null otherwise, or when no rate is known.

projects.description: Projects the report covers, named as they were; empty means all.

total_cents.description:
TotalCents sums the items' prices, on a list too; null when none
has a price.

rate.description: Rate is hryvnias for one unit of the report's currency: "45.0256".

rate_on.description:
RateOn is the day the National Bank of Ukraine set the rate for: the
day the report was paid, or today while it isn't (or the latest day
before, when the bank can't be reached).

notes.description: Notes say what was done in the task (shown in a detailed report).

price_cents.description: PriceCents is null for a task without a price.

price_in_uah_cents.description:
PriceInUAHCents is the price in hryvnias at the report's rate (see
in_uah), each rounded on its own; null without a price or a rate.

seconds.description: Seconds is the time a task billed by the hour took; null for a fixed price.

kind.description: Kind switches between "basic" and "detailed"; omitted, it stays.

archived_at.description:
ArchivedAt is set once the task is archived: off the boards and closed
to changes. ArchivedBy is the paid report that archived it, null when
its owner did.

billed.description:
Billed is true once the task is on a sent report: its time and an
hourly price stay as they were billed.

billing.description:
Billing is "fixed" or "hourly": then the price is TrackedSeconds at
HourlyRateCents. Like the price, the time and the rate are null for
whoever doesn't see the price.

can_archive.description:
CanArchive is true on the viewer's own personal task, which they may
put in the archive by hand.

can_see_price.description:
CanSeePrice is false for a member of the client's team: the price is
left out for them.

can_track_time.description: CanTrackTime is true for the task's freelancer, who writes time on it.

client.description: Client is null for a personal task.

creator.description:
Creator is who set the task — the freelancer, the client, or a member
of the client's company.

freelancer.description: Freelancer is null while the task has no assignee.

participants.description:
Participants are who took part: the freelancer first, then everyone who
set, commented on, attached to or changed the task.

price_cents.description:
PriceCents is null while the task has no price; Currency is the
freelancer's.

project.description: Project is null for a task outside any project.

status_id.description:
Status is the category; StatusID and StatusName the exact workflow
status (board column), Position the card's place in it.

on_task.description: OnTask is whether they're a participant already.

personal.description:
Personal makes a task with no other side: a client's own (a freelancer's
is made by leaving client_id empty). Create only.

price.description:
Price is an amount like "1200.50", set by a freelancer on create only;
PUT /api/v1/tasks/{id}/price changes it later.

priority.description:
Priority is set on create only ("none" when left out); PUT
/api/v1/tasks/{id}/priority changes it later.

project_id.description:
ProjectID puts the task in a project; on edit null keeps the current
project and "" takes the task out of it.

status_id.description: StatusID creates the task straight in a board column (create only).

status.description:
Status moves the task to the first column of a category; StatusID to an
exact column.

role.description: Role is what they join as: "member" or "contractor".

available.description:
Available are the kinds that can go to Telegram; DefaultKinds those on
when a chat is connected.

enabled.description: Enabled is false when the server has no bot.

username.description: Username is the connected Telegram account's @handle, or its first name.

can_edit.description: CanEdit is true for the author, who may change and delete it.

seconds.description:
Seconds is the time so far; while RunningSince is set the timer adds
the time since then.

hourly_rate_cents.description: HourlyRateCents is a freelancer's rate for an hour of work; null when unset.

locale.description: Locale is the language they read Helpic in: "en" or "uk".

member_of.description: MemberOf is set for a member of a client's company; null otherwise.

two_factor.description: TwoFactor is on when signing in also takes a code from an authenticator app.

role.description:
Role is "member" (sees all the company's work) or "contractor" (only
the tasks they set or were added to).
